standards_review.notes: All 21 commit subjects in the range match the documented 'EPMCDME-13903: Capital sentence' format (no zero ID, capitalized first word, no trailing period). However two commits (c2e1d7bb9, 4a05a8d00) also carry unrelated changes -- a personal .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json profile rewrite and 3 docs/codemie/analytics/*.json local session logs -- violating git-workflow.md's Anti-Patterns row 'Mixing unrelated changes in one commit'.
No .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md exists in the repo and no code_quality ArtifactRef was passed by the caller; no documented code-quality standard exists to adjudicate this change against.

security-patterns.md's checklist (HTML sinks/dangerouslySetInnerHTML, redirects built from untrusted input, cross-window postMessage, secrets/config) is fully satisfied across every changed src/ file in this range -- no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML, location.href/assign/replace, window.open, postMessage, or new secret was introduced. The apiKey value in .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json is the pre-existing literal 'sso-provided', not a credential. However docs/codemie/analytics/*.json, added by commits 4a05a8d00 and c2e1d7bb9, are local AI-tooling telemetry logs containing the developer's email address (andriy_lukashchuk@epam.com) and local absolute filesystem path (/Users/Andriy_Lukashchuk/Dev/code-assistant-ui) -- a concrete personal-information disclosure into shared repo history, independent of any documented checklist item.

blocking_findings.violation: git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns forbids 'Mixing unrelated changes in one commit'; this commit rewrites the developer's personal CLI profile (activeProfile, profile name, model aliases, codemieAssistants list) with no relation to the tool-call-confirmation feature.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Unrelated personal tooling config churn obscures the feature diff for reviewers and risks merging one developer's local environment settings into main.
blocking_findings.remedy: git checkout de6104d7337c8b77d2f3582e32775c7fa526c142 -- .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json (or drop the file from the branch) before merge.

blocking_findings.violation: Three local AI-assistant analytics session logs, unrelated to EPMCDME-13903, were committed as part of feature commits; they carry the developer's email address and local absolute filesystem path. This both violates the 'one logical change per commit' anti-pattern in git-workflow.md and discloses personal information into shared repo history.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Publishes personal identifying information (email, local machine path) into the repository's permanent git history and mixes unrelated generated artifacts into the feature branch.
blocking_findings.remedy: git rm the three docs/codemie/analytics/*.json files from this branch and add the analytics output directory to .gitignore if it is meant to stay local-only.
